5	## Fig 1: RASP Pipeline Overview

7	**类型**: 流程/架构图（method figure）

9	**内容**:
10	```

12	        │
13	        ├──────────────────────────┐
14	        ▼                          ▼
15	  Importance I(h)           CKA Overlap F(h)
16	  (Taylor gradient)        (intra-layer pairwise)
17	        │                          │
18	        └──────────┬───────────────┘
19	                   ▼
20	        RASP Score: S(h) = I(h) × (1 - F(h))^α
21	                   │
22	                   ▼
23	        Structured Pruning (remove lowest S(h))
24	                   │
25	                   ▼
26	        ┌──────────┴──────────┐

28	  SFT Warmup              [对比: Standard Pruning]
29	  (fix generation)         只用 I(h), 无 F(h) 修正
30	        │
31	        ▼
32	  GRPO RLVR Recovery
33	  (restore reasoning)
34	        │
35	        ▼
36	  Recovered Compact Model

**内容**:
```
Pre-trained Reasoning LLM (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B)
        │
        ├──────────────────────────┐
        ▼                          ▼
  Importance I(h)           CKA Overlap F(h)
  (Taylor gradient)        (intra-layer pairwise)
        │                          │
        └──────────┬───────────────┘
                   ▼
        RASP Score: S(h) = I(h) × (1 - F(h))^α
                   │
                   ▼
        Structured Pruning (remove lowest S(h))
                   │
                   ▼
        ┌──────────┴──────────┐
        ▼                     ▼
  SFT Warmup              [对比: Standard Pruning]
  (fix generation)         只用 I(h), 无 F(h) 修正
        │
        ▼
  GRPO RLVR Recovery
  (restore reasoning)
        │
        ▼
  Recovered Compact Model
